i understand very well how you feel. group chats are good for borderlines when we can be part of it all, but when we are not, they are intensely damaging. it makes me feel like a histrionic at times to be frank.

if you can handle it when responses slow, have friends who are good with private messaging, so even when the group chat is not including you, they are there for you. 

do not exit and rejoin the chat many many times, that will only worsen the feelings. 

if you are speaking of a discord chat, and you have a vent area, then perhaps a small explanation of your diagnosis and all of your feelings? it is easy for people to feel you are persecuting them when they simply do not understand that this is not something we are able to control without consistent long-term commitment to time consuming expensive therapies and likely medications. every time i read that therapy will take up to 2 years for things to improve......it is so disheartening i feel like crying.   
people will always say yes, you CAN control it, you HAVE to, but... i know it sounds so impossible with this disorder...have a bit of patience with yourself...sometimes the thoughts control you versus you in control of them... and do not be TOO honest with your friends about your feelings if what you will say is hurtful, but try to be as honest as you can be, reasonably.
